label: end-of-episode clock (trials ~90-99), GO/D2 steps
explanation: Episode-position unit. It never fires before trial ~80 and has 98% of its activation mass in trials 90-99, where the value head has dropped (value < 5.22 covers 99% of mass), so it tracks an internal end-of-episode clock or falling value. Inside that window it fires mainly on GO (54% of mass) and D2 (40%) and rarely on D1, least of all after a rewarded D1. Magnitude grows toward the last trials and is larger on a2 choices (74% of mass is on a2 trials, model_act=a2 lift 1.9x) and on GO steps that follow unrewarded outcomes. It also fires strongly on rare penalty / D1-fixation-error steps (in_rew=-1, d1_err=1). It does not encode the task structure (common/rare, reward pattern, stay/switch are all near 1x). ep_trial >= 90 alone gives mass recall 0.98 but precision 0.49. Dropping D1 and moving the threshold to 92 gives the best F1 (0.75 dev). Adding action==2 lowers F1. The predicate uses only observed or internal variables; ep_trial is not an input, but the GRU can count it.
